blocks.title: Recall equivalent parts
blocks.instructions: Use an equal-whole bar to explain why changing both numerator and denominator preserves a fraction.

blocks.title: Connect a model and calculation
blocks.instructions: Model a fresh unlike-denominator sum with strips, then write the matching equivalent-fraction steps.

blocks.title: Practice matching representations
blocks.instructions: Pairs solve fresh sums and connect each renamed fraction to equal-sized parts in their models.

blocks.title: Word problems
blocks.instructions: Use ten minutes for the three-question Word problems assignment. Record actual help. Discuss the context and units in the remaining five minutes.

blocks.title: Explain a common unit
blocks.instructions: Students explain why the addends must count the same-sized parts before addition.
